successCriteria.description: Running `npm run dev` at the repo root starts BOTH the API server (via the root `start` script, `ts-node src/index.ts`) and the web dev server (via `web/`'s `dev` script, `vite`) as concurrent child processes, and both are alive and producing output after startup.
Each line of a child's stdout/stderr is forwarded to the parent terminal prefixed with a stable per-process label, so output from the API and the web server is distinguishable in the combined stream.
When either child process exits, the runner terminates the sibling process and exits with the exited child's exit code (a non-zero child code yields a non-zero runner exit).
Sending SIGINT (Ctrl-C) or SIGTERM to the runner tears down BOTH children and then exits, leaving no orphaned API or Vite process behind.
The root `package.json` `scripts` block contains a `dev` entry whose value is exactly `node scripts/dev.js`.

constraints: `scripts/dev.js` must be CommonJS (use `require`), matching the repo root convention — the root `package.json` has no `"type"` field (defaults to CommonJS) and the existing `scripts/smoke.js` already uses `require`.

The spawned commands must match the existing scripts exactly: the API is `npm run start` with `cwd` set to the repo root, and the web dev server is `npm run dev` with `cwd` set to `web/`. Do not inline `ts-node src/index.ts` or `vite` directly.
Use Node's `child_process.spawn` with `stdio` piped and a per-process prefix applied to each stream; do not use `exec`/`execSync` for the long-running children.
The API server must remain on port 3000 — do not modify `src/index.ts` or `web/vite.config.ts` (the Vite proxy targets `http://localhost:3000`).
outOfScope: No changes to `src/index.ts`, `web/vite.config.ts`, or `web/package.json` — the API port and the Vite proxy configuration are out of scope for this phase.
No dependency on Phase 1 (seed module / `npm run seed`); the dev runner must work without the seed having been run.
No process-manager features: no daemonization, no automatic restart-on-crash, no watch/rebuild of the API process, no log-file persistence.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The API child command must reuse the root `start` script verbatim (`ts-node src/index.ts`) as defined in the root `package.json` `scripts.start`.
The web child command must reuse the `web/` `dev` script verbatim (`vite`) as defined in `web/package.json` `scripts.dev`.
The new `scripts/dev.js` must follow the CommonJS `require` convention already established by the existing `scripts/smoke.js`.

integrationPoints.why: The API child process is spawned by invoking this script; the runner must not re-implement the API boot command.
The web dev server child process is spawned by invoking this script with cwd `web/`.
The web client proxies API routes to the API server, so the API must be reachable on port 3000 for the combined dev experience to function.
